page.title: Delivery matrix
page.purpose: Answer the operator's first question — which Android targets can I prove right now, what did the last run show, and what is blocking me.

priorities.statement: Every target row shows a probed disposition, never an assumed one.
priorities.notes: A host being Linux does not imply an emulator works. The row reflects what the last probe proved.

priorities.statement: An unavailable target names its missing capability and next action inline.
priorities.notes: 'Unavailable' with no reason forces the operator into the CLI to find out why, which defeats the surface.

priorities.statement: The gate verdict is visible without opening a run.
priorities.notes: The operator's question is 'may this ship', not 'what happened in run 47'.

priorities.statement: A blocked release readiness rung is reachable from here in one step.
priorities.notes: Discovering at the end of a green matrix that no Play account exists is the failure this surface exists to prevent.

states.description: The matrix as the live system reports it.
Target inventory is being probed; no dispositions are asserted yet.
No generated project exists yet. Explains how to generate one rather than showing an empty table.
Targets are listed and at least one is unavailable — the normal working state on a host without the Android SDK, not a degraded one.
A required cell failed. The gate reads failed and names the contributing cell.

claims.statement: Every disposition is distinguishable without relying on hue — each carries a shape or text label as well as a status colour.
claims.rationale: DESIGN.md accessibility floor. 'unsupported' and 'unavailable' are semantically opposite — terminal versus actionable — and must not depend on colour discrimination to tell apart.

claims.statement: No target row shows 'unavailable' without an adjacent missing capability and next action.
claims.rationale: S2A-P0-003. An unavailable state with no reason is indistinguishable from a bug, and sends the operator to the CLI.

claims.statement: Every verdict on this page is perceivable without playing a recording.
claims.rationale: Journey video is evidence, not interface.
